description: This file provides utility methods for generated code in Orleans serialization, including service resolution, type handling, and exception copying helpers.

classes.name: RecursiveServiceResolutionState
classes.description: Maintains thread-local state for nested service resolution calls, tracking call depth and caller objects.

classes.name: OrleansGeneratedCodeHelper
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for generated serialization code within Orleans, including service resolution, type handling, and exception copying.

classes.name: ExceptionCopier`<T, B>`
classes.description: Abstract base class for deep copying exception types, utilizing service resolution for an activator and base type copier.

methods.name: GetService
methods.description: Resolves and unwraps a service, avoiding nested resolutions from the same caller.

methods.name: UnwrapService
methods.description: Unwraps nested wrapped services for a given service instance.

methods.name: TryGetService
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a caller object matching a specific service type from the thread-local call stack.

methods.name: GetOptionalCopier
methods.description: Returns the copier if it's not shallow-copyable, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: InvokableThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException for invalid argument indices.

methods.name: ConsumeEndBaseOrEndObject
methods.description: Consumes expected empty content markers during deserialization.

methods.name: SerializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Serializes a value of an unexpected type.

methods.name: DeserializeUnexpectedType
methods.description: Deserializes a value of an unexpected type.

methods.name: GetMethodInfoOrDefault
